{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > generate_chart.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Define the data
records = [
    ("North", "A", 12, 10, 6),
    ("North", "B", 8, 12, 7),
    ("South", "A", 15, 9, 5),
    ("South", "C", 20, 7, 4),
    ("East", "A", 10, 11, 8),
    ("East", "B", 14, 6, 2),
    ("West", "C", 9, 13, 9),
    ("West", "A", 18, 8, 3)
]

# Filter records with units >= 10
filtered_records = [r for r in records if r[2] >= 10]

# Calculate profit for each remaining record
profit_data = []
for region, product, units, price, cost in filtered_records:
    profit = (price - cost) * units
    profit_data.append((region, profit))

# Sum profit by region
region_profit = {}
for region, profit in profit_data:
    region_profit[region] = region_profit.get(region, 0) + profit

# Sort regions by total profit (descending)
sorted_regions = sorted(region_profit.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

# Extract data for plotting
regions = [item[0] for item in sorted_regions]
profits = [item[1] for item in sorted_regions]

# Create horizontal bar chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5), dpi=120)

# Create horizontal bars with dark green color
bars = ax.barh(regions, profits, color='darkgreen')

# Label every bar with its exact total
for bar in bars:
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
            f'{width}', 
            ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10)

# Set x-axis to start at zero
ax.set_xlim(0, max(profits) * 1.1)

# Label axes
ax.set_xlabel('Total Profit')
ax.set_ylabel('Region')

# Set title
ax.set_title('Filtered Profit by Region')

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Chart saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
